review_confirmed.meaning: Adjudicated confirm/reject under the occurrence review protocol
review_confirmed.unit_of_analysis: one Event at its immutable assessment snapshot
review_confirmed.decision_time: snapshot collected_at, before first reviewer action
review_confirmed.limitations: Review agreement is not severity, risk, or priority
review_confirmed.annotation_protocol: two independent qualified reviewers, blinded to model/rule scores; disagreement requires attributed adjudication
review_confirmed.observation_time: persisted immutable snapshot before first review; all features available by declared cutoff
review_confirmed.diversity: report independent scenes/segments, classes, sources, domains, detector versions and missingness
review_confirmed.sample_size: determine by target prevalence, clustered uncertainty and power; current provisional floor is not evidence
review_confirmed.validation: temporal+group isolation; separate early stopping, calibration and final holdout; no protected-set reuse
review_confirmed.baseline: training prior for binary target; simple target-matched model for other tasks
review_confirmed.early_stopping: validation-only metric; patience and budget fixed before fitting
